title: Leopards & Blue Whales: A 5-Day Southern Coast & Yala Safari Itinerary
author: Adventure Guide Team
excerpt: Combine thrilling dawn jeep safaris in Yala National Park with golden palm beaches, surf breaks, and ethical whale watching in Mirissa and Galle.
content:
Where Jungle Meets the Indian Ocean

Few places on the planet let you photograph wild leopards and Asian elephants at dawn and swim alongside sea turtles in warm turquoise bays by afternoon. Southern Sri Lanka delivers this rare combination effortlessly.

Days 1–2: Yala National Park Safari

Yala Block 1 boasts one of the highest densities of leopards in the world, alongside sloth bears, mugger crocodiles, and peacocks. Book a private 4x4 safari jeep entering at 6:00 AM when big cats are most active along the sandy tracks.

Want fewer jeeps? Ask your driver to take you into Yala Block 5 or neighboring Udawalawe National Park for extraordinary elephant sightings.

Days 3–4: Mirissa & Weligama Surf Coast

Head west along the palm-fringed coast to Mirissa. Climb Coconut Tree Hill at golden hour, take a beginner surf lesson on the gentle sandy break of Weligama Bay, and join a responsible morning cruise to spot mighty blue whales offshore.

Day 5: Galle Dutch Fort

Wrap up your southern adventure walking the 17th-century ramparts of UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, browsing boutique spice shops, and watching sunset by the iconic Galle Lighthouse.
